subject: Intro: Dedicated capacity demo for Velox Analytics - throughput & latency requirements
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom@veloxanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for low-latency inference

Hi Jordan,

We just spun up a trial with Redwood and our infra team flagged that we'll likely need a dedicated offering. Short background: Velox Analytics runs real-time financial signal processing and we need consistent p95 latency under 150ms at approximately 300 requests/sec (payloads ~1k tokens) for a quantized 70B model.

We filled the self-serve form earlier and attached a preliminary capacity sheet with traffic patterns and network topology (see attached). Can we schedule a short walkthrough focused on Dedicated capacity — specifically throughput targets, autoscale behavior, and how caching/batching would affect latency for our workload?

Availability: any time next week morning PST would work.

Thanks,
Tom Hayes
Head of ML Infrastructure
Velox Analytics
Attachment: network_topology.png (image/png)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom@veloxanalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for low-latency inference

Hi Tom — thanks for reaching out and for the detailed note. Jordan here (AE). Appreciate the traffic profile — that helps a lot.

Short answer: yes, Dedicated is what we'd recommend for consistent p95 SLOs at those volumes. For the walkthrough, I can cover:
- how Reserved capacity maps to p95 latency and throughput
- batching/caching tradeoffs and recommended settings for 1k-token payloads
- autoscale and burst strategies for headroom
- deployment/region options and networking considerations

Proposed 30-min slots:
- Tue 2026-11-20 10:00 AM PST
- Tue 2026-11-20 03:00 PM PST

I’ve attached a short intake worksheet (capacity_requirements.xlsx) — filling the shaded fields will let our SE tailor the demo to your request pattern. Could you confirm a slot and drop any missing numbers in that sheet?

Looping in Priyom (CS/solutions coordinator) to help gather pre-demo items. If you have a security contact who wants to join, we can invite them as well.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: capacity_requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

If 2:00 PM works, please send a calendar invite and we'll accept.
